_about: Questions written by a model from the R1043 record and each expert's own profile, then read by a person before being committed. The engine prefers this file over a live call, and a live call over the deterministic bank. Every place and actor named here appears in the risk record itself (Adre, Tina, Abeche, Ouaddai, Wadi Fira, Sila, Ennedi Est, Darfur, RSF, SAF); nothing is invented, because a question naming a road that does not exist is worse than a generic one.

_roles: Each question declares the role the card routes on: decomposition, conditional, premortem, base_rate, minority, observable, provenance, context. Step 3 always serves a debiasing role (premortem, base_rate or minority), so the ACAPS-named mitigations do not depend on thresholds.
